dataset.name: Japanese advanced colon-cancer cohort (GSE192667)
dataset.description: Independent primary colon-cancer cohort with FFPE bulk RNA sequencing and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The source study profiled 89 untreated primary colorectal tumors from 89 patients, including 66 stage IV cancers. TRACE Explorer restricts this release to the 62 tumors arising in the cecum or ascending, transverse, descending or sigmoid colon. The 27 rectal tumors are exposed separately under TCGA-READ and are never pooled with this cohort.

metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus and the CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 publication
metadata.library_method: Bulk mRNA sequencing of FFPE primary colorectal tumors; reads were aligned to GRCh38 with STAR 2.7.1a, counted with featureCounts in Rsubread and converted to TPM against Ensembl release 98
metadata.endpoint_context: Source-provided overall survival in a predominantly advanced colorectal-cancer cohort
metadata.endpoint_caveat: GEO provides exact individual OS months and Alive/Dead status but does not state whether time begins at diagnosis, resection, sampling or treatment. TRACE Explorer therefore preserves the source endpoint without claiming harmonization to a specific clinical origin.
metadata.sample_selection_note: Expression eligibility is applied before one-sample-per-patient selection. Every patient has one primary-tumor profile; source_name_ch1 deterministically assigns colon or rectum before endpoint QC.
metadata.disease_selection_note: Cecum and ascending, transverse, descending and sigmoid colon tumors are assigned to TCGA-COAD. Rectal tumors from the same parent series are registered as a separate, non-overlapping TCGA-READ release.
metadata.expression_processing_note: The source-provided Ensembl release 98 TPM values are transformed as log2(TPM + 1). Ensembl identifiers are mapped with the pinned release 98 GTF; ambiguous symbol mappings are excluded.
metadata.overlap_note: This colon release and the companion rectal release share a GEO parent series but contain disjoint patients selected by the source-reported primary site.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the public GEO files in place. Source-file redistribution is disabled; NCBI GEO terms remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: Untreated FFPE primary colon tumor, one bulk RNA profile per patient

expression.label: GEO gene-level TPM transformed to log2(TPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Pinned Ensembl release 98 GRCh38 gene_name annotation
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The 58,825 source Ensembl identifiers are unique in every selected profile. Symbols mapped from more than one Ensembl row are excluded rather than combined without an unambiguous gene-level rule.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer applies log2(TPM + 1) to the source-provided gene-level TPM. Values are suitable for within-cohort analysis and are not cross-study normalized.

endpoints.label: Source-provided overall survival
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause as encoded by the GEO outcome field; Alive records are censored at the source-provided follow-up
